historical_source.locator: User Portuguese BPHS CP1252 line2343; Sanskrit BPHS Chapter26 verse12
historical_source.meaning: In Jupiter's eighth full-sign offset (240–270° oriented difference), source language gives 60 minus twice local degrees. At 270° the ordinary Ch26.6–9 formula resumes, yielding 15.

modern_commentary.author: Ernst Wilhelm
modern_commentary.layer: Modern commentator's conjectural Sanskrit emendation; not a discovered different ancient manuscript
modern_commentary.argument: Literal Jupiter 240–270 formula reaches zero at 270° before ordinary continuation at 15; Wilhelm argues this is abnormal and proposes a continuous taper from 60 to 15 across the sector.

secondary_digital_table.disposition: Do not implement defective secondary table automatically, nor treat it as original Sanskrit or an observed prediction result.
